title: Tiwai Island: Rainforest Safari
summary: Three nights on a rainforest island in the Moa River — primate walks at dawn, a canoe crossing for hippo sign at dusk, and evenings with almost no light but the stars.
highlights: A dawn primate walk with a community guide
Canoeing the Moa River at dusk for hippo sign
A guided night walk for nocturnal wildlife
A visit to a Mende village bordering the reserve

itinerary.title: Arrive on Tiwai
itinerary.description: Road transfer from Bo, then a canoe crossing onto the island and a welcome briefing on the reserve.

itinerary.title: Primates at dawn, hippos at dusk
itinerary.description: An early primate walk, a slow afternoon, and a canoe trip at dusk watching for hippo sign.

itinerary.title: Night walk & village visit
itinerary.description: A guided night walk for nocturnal wildlife, then a morning visit to a bordering Mende village.

included: All guided walks and the river canoe trip
Ground transfer from Bo or Kenema
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
excluded: Community conservation fee, paid on arrival
